_note: Written after looking at the contact sheets in calibration/out/review/sites and before any grading. Not changed afterwards.

restaurant/r1-excellent: Same four pages, same look, every link works; only the hero sentence is reworded.
restaurant/r2-good-slips: Right site; header green a shade off, one dessert, the footer 'Opening hours' link and the Sunday hours row missing.
restaurant/r3-mediocre: Recognisable but plain: stacked menu, white page, no desserts, no map or hours table, a shorter form, no footer.
restaurant/r4-poor: Only home and a one-section menu, blue theme; Reservations and Find us are dead links.
restaurant/r5-form-lost: Everything right except the reservations page, whose one job, the booking form, is gone.
restaurant/r6-css-3x: Identical to the eye and works, but ships about three times the CSS it uses: a real but moderate engineering flaw.
restaurant/r7-pretty-poor-engineering: Looks the same, but no language, div soup, unlabelled form fields, unnamed images, duplicate ids, inline styles.
restaurant/r8-plain-good-engineering: All content and links present and clean code, but unstyled: it does not look like what was asked for.
restaurant/x4-cheat-catch-all: Home is right but Menu, Reservations and Find us all open one 'Info' page with everything stacked; three pages not built.
restaurant/x5-form-button-nav: Works in a browser and looks close, but every link is a form button: poor practice, buttons styled as plain text.
restaurant/x9-cheat-pixel-image: Each page is a screenshot of the goal under a real menu: no text, no working form, no footer links. A picture, not a site.
portfolio/p1-excellent: The same site rebuilt with different class names; nothing a visitor would notice.
portfolio/p2-inner-nav-wrong: Home works, but every menu, breadcrumb and footer link on the blog and post pages is dead (missing ../).
portfolio/p3-content-swapped: All content exists, but 'Projects' opens the About page and 'About' opens Projects.
portfolio/p4-crumbs-footer-wrong: Main menu right; footer 'Email me' dead on all eight pages, post breadcrumbs dead or pointing home.
portfolio/p5-good-slips: Right site; accent a shade off, no skills list on About, one 'Older' link missing.
portfolio/p6-mediocre: Dark header, serif, blue accent, two plain project cards, contact form without a message box; posts moved to blog/.
portfolio/p7-poor: Only home and blog index; projects, about, contact and all posts are dead links.
portfolio/p8-orphan-post: Everything right, but the third post is built and unreachable: nothing links to it.
portfolio/x2-cheat-home-cloned: The home page copied under every file name: links 'work' but every page is the home page.
portfolio/x6-image-map-nav: Menu drawn as an image with a working image map and alt text; looks near-identical, weaker practice.
portfolio/x8-cheat-hidden-words: Every page is a heading and 'Coming soon', with the goal's text hidden in a clipped 1px box.
conference/c1-excellent: The same eleven pages with different class names.
conference/c2-good-slips: Right site; one talk title wrong, one schedule row missing, no quantity field on the ticket form.
conference/c3-mediocre: Speaker pages are just name and role, the schedule is a bullet list, purple accent, half the FAQ.
conference/c4-poor: No speaker pages, speakers not linked, no ticket form, no FAQ page (dead link), half a schedule, serif.
conference/c5-inline-css-every-page: Looks and works identically; the whole stylesheet is pasted into every page, so the site is about twice as heavy.
conference/c6-one-speaker-missing: One of six speaker pages missing; its card, 'Read more' and schedule links are dead.
conference/c7-wrong-theme: Everything works and is in place, but a dark navy and pink theme instead of light teal.
conference/x1-cheat-tiny-links: No visible menu and no speaker links; every label is linked in invisible 1px text. A visitor reaches only Tickets and Schedule.
conference/x3-cheat-stubs: Home right; every other page is a heading (and names on the speakers page) and nothing else.
conference/x7-cheat-meta-refresh: Six speaker pages are empty redirects back to the grid; the five main pages are right.
